In many research works, this has been formulated and solved as a centralized or hierarchical optimization problem. The problem under consideration is formulated as a two-armed bandit (charging or not) for each instant. The proposed algorithm finds the best combination of arms to play with a computational complexity O(m) linear with the number of arms.
